subject: The parked status of the FOVEATE lens (field-lens.js FIELD_FOVEATE)

human_comparator.stated_result: No notable or self-evident advantage observed for FOVEATED over PLAIN in direct use.

self_disclaimer.meaning: The receipt that parked the lens explicitly disclaims proving the very comparison it reports as resolved. The conclusion is not supported by its own attachment.

contrast_a_properly_run_pass.why_it_counts: names its method (36 browser cases), its workflow run, its observed friction per surface, and classifies each: AUTHORITY_BUG, DEAD_AFFORDANCE, DUPLICATE_SURFACE + LABEL_DRIFT. Observed before and after.
contrast_a_properly_run_pass.note: This is what a real pass looks like in this repo. The foveate park has no equivalent.

ruling.by_law: A NUMBER THAT CANNOT NAME ITS SOURCE FILE IS NOT ALLOWED ON A PAGE (GODSEYE rule, adopted 2026-09-21).
ruling.verdict: The park stands as a RECORD OF A BELIEF, not as a finding. It may not be cited as evidence that foveation does not work.
ruling.not_asserted: This correction does NOT claim foveation DOES work. No properly-run trial exists in either direction. The question is OPEN, not settled.

recovered_prior_art.why_it_matters: The original FU mechanism was foveate -> radial ring as ONE operational chain, recovered from the conversation archive.

mechanisms.name: FOVEATE_OPERATOR

mechanisms.name: INPUT_TO_FOCUS_TO_RING

recovered_prior_art.consequence: The cursor-lens built at fovea-lens.js (2026-09-23) is not a novelty and not the parked band-dimmer. It is the recovered foveate -> ring chain, re-aimed at the pointer.
